_notes: Per-operation perf budgets, used by tests/test_perf_regression.py.
Each entry pairs a description with a budget_ms ceiling.
The test takes BEST-OF-N (default 5) samples and asserts the best
sample beats the budget. Best-of-N is intentional: under parallel
test-suite load + GC noise, p50/p99 are unreliable, but 'is the
code CAPABLE of meeting the budget' is a real regression signal.
Decrease (tighten) a budget when code legitimately gets faster.
Increase (loosen) ONLY with a written justification in the same PR
(e.g. 'BioPython 1.92 changed CompoundLocation evaluation cost').
Baselines were measured 2026-05-17 on WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 / Python 3.12
with the suite already warm. Ceilings carry 3-5x headroom over the
measured best-of-5 so machine-to-machine variance doesn't trip the
gate.
2026-11-09: the gate covered 6 operations, so the digest, the codon
optimizer, the scanners, the GenBank readers/writers and the data
layer could all regress silently (audit [INV-234]). 13 added below,
measured best-of-5 on Linux 7.0 / Python 3.14 with the machine quiet,
ceilings at ~4x per the headroom rule above. Each one CLEARS the LRU
it would otherwise hit — an uncleared `_ENZYME_CUTS_CACHE` made the
digest measure 0.01 ms, i.e. nothing at all.

scan_restriction_sites_puc19.description: _scan_restriction_sites on a pUC19-size (2686 bp) random sequence

build_seq_text_puc19.description: _build_seq_text on pUC19-size (2686 bp) with 10 features, cold cache per call

build_seq_text_20kb.description: _build_seq_text on 20 kb with 80 features, cold cache per call

digest_with_enzymes_50kb.description: _digest_with_enzymes: 50 kb circular, 6 enzymes, 100 features carried onto the fragments, cold `_ENZYME_CUTS_CACHE`. The core cloning primitive, including the intron-aware feature carry.

record_to_gb_text_100kb.description: _record_to_gb_text on 100 kb with 500 features — the save/export path.

gb_text_to_record_100kb.description: _gb_text_to_record on 100 kb / 500-feature GenBank text, cold `_GB_PARSE_CACHE`. Every library load goes through this.

insdc_parse_genbank_100kb.description: splicecraft_insdc.parse_genbank on 100 kb / 500 features — SpliceCraft's own GenBank reader, the one every door reads through ([INV-219]).

codon_optimize_500aa.description: _codon_optimize on a 500-residue protein against a 64-codon table. Mission-critical; cheap, and a regression here would be felt in every synthesis design.

splice_scan_5kb.description: _splice_scan on 5 kb, both strands — the trained plant donor/acceptor PWMs.

codon_fix_splice_sites_300aa.description: _codon_fix_splice_sites on a 300-residue CDS whose fixture genuinely needs TWO synonymous repairs, so this gates the repair loop and not just the scan. (A first draft set the ceiling from a probe that had warmed state the test does not have, and measured 0.40 ms for what is really ~3.7 ms — measure through the test's own path.)

scan_terminators_5kb.description: _scan_terminators on 5 kb — folds a hairpin per U-tract candidate (Turner NN), so it is the heaviest scanner per base. Linear in length with a large constant.

cassette_internal_repeats_10kb.description: _cassette_internal_repeats on 10 kb at min_len 100 — direct AND inverted, indexes every k-mer then walks the reverse complement. Backs the scan-repeats endpoint.

typed_clone_library_1000.description: _typed_clone of a 1,000-entry library with 12 features each — the deep-clone-on-read that sacred #17 requires on every `_load_X()`. `_iter_X_readonly()` exists to avoid it on hot read paths; this gates the cost when it IS paid.

plasmid_map_load_record_2000_feats.description: PlasmidMap.load_record on 20 kb with 2,000 features. Cost tracks FEATURE COUNT, not bp ([INV-223]); this is the repaint tail shared by undo, redo and flip.
